newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Cocoa's upside bias seen intact.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Cocoa's upside bias seen intact.

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Cocoa futures are likely to trade in a range but with an upside bias, with September possibly testing the key 1,060 stg a tonne resistance, technical analysts said on Friday.
Traders called the market to open five stg lower.
Cocoa regained a foothold above the 1,000 stg area -- now seen as a key support, this week.
"It came up quite well and I think there's a chance it would go a bit higher, probably going back to the 1,060 area, which is now the major resistance," said Susan Rigg, an analyst at Chart Analysis.
She said the market rallied when it crossed the 1,060 area in mid-June. That rally took the market to a high of 1,170.
"I think at the moment, it's quite positive and it should go up a bit further after having rallied through the psychological 1,000 stg level this week," she said.
"The dynamics are good and it should go further up."
A break below 1,000 could set the market back to the most recent low of 965.
"But there's a lot of underlying support...so the downside potential will be limited," she added.
